reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing interface add-on for DeepSeek Harness Web: it appears as a bottom-right overlay indicator that reports whether pricing is in peak or off-peak period and shows the next switch countdown, with a detail card on click. Its manifest and README show it is a web client plugin integrated through DSH’s patch/bundle mechanism rather than a code-generation or data-processing utility. Conservatively, the main risk is informational accuracy tied to time-window logic rather than privilege or external execution.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在界面右下角显示当前是否处于高峰（梁文峰）或低谷（梁文谷）时段，并提供下一次切换倒计时与点击查看的说明。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays current peak/off-peak status in a bottom-right badge, with a countdown to the next switch and expandable details when clicked.

capabilities: Shows a live peak/valley indicator and countdown in a Web UI overlay.
Provides a clickable status badge/card with pricing-window details.
Loads as a browser-side DSH client plugin and can be installed/removed via DSH plugin commands.

reasons.code: README describes a right-bottom overlay badge that refreshes every second with peak/valley status and HH:MM:SS switch countdown, and that it can expand to show period and price details.
package.json declares dsh.bundle patch metadata and a web client entrypoint (platform web, ./client export), confirming browser-side UI injection.
Repository files include web client source and overlay integration paths (src/client/index.ts, cordis.patch.yml), matching the described UI panel behavior.
